notes.text: No random draws or timing claims. Inputs are content-addressed in the preserved spike38 S3 run index; this experiment creates new local/Git certificates only.
The certificate concerns the original highest-form ideal; it does not compute FFD, LFD, affine solving degree, or rank factor bases.
